description:
The marketing analytics team needs to monitor mobile organic search traffic as a distinct audience segment for campaign optimization. Set up Matomo to support this by:

1. Creating a visitor segment that captures users who both (a) arrive via organic search channels and (b) are on mobile devices. Both conditions must apply simultaneously.

2. Scheduling an automated weekly email report that uses this new segment. The report must be sent every Monday to the email address analytics@marketingteam.test and should cover visitor and acquisition metrics.

The goal is a fully configured segment-plus-report pipeline so the team receives automatic weekly updates on mobile organic search performance.

Login credentials: admin / Admin12345
